component.name: IPMI Connect
component.summary: Java-free remote console for legacy server BMCs

description.p: IPMI Connect replaces the Java Web Start KVM consoles of older Dell (Avocent), Supermicro (ATEN) and ASUS (AMI MegaRAC) baseboard management controllers. It speaks their KVM and virtual media protocols itself and shows the console in its own window: video, keyboard, mouse, power control and virtual media from local disk images. Support for AMI MegaRAC is experimental.

ul.li: BMC certificates are verified, or pinned by SHA-256 fingerprint after you confirm them
Obsolete TLS and unencrypted BMC channels are used only after explicit consent, and shown in a persistent indicator
Passwords are never stored or logged
The local console listens on loopback only and requires a one-time sign-in link

description.p: These BMCs predate modern security: some channels cannot be encrypted. Use them only on a dedicated, trusted management network.

description.p: Browser console for Dell C6220 II and Supermicro X8DTL-6F BMCs, with power control and virtual media.
